pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, soft-edged polygonal regions with low-contrast pixel gradients at the margins. The patches on the lower neck are smaller and more densely packed, while flank patches are larger with more varied geometric expansion.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Broad, high-luminance negative space forming a continuous topological web. Junction nodes are wide with diffuse transitions into the darker patches. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dark-toned mane along the upper neck line. The 1D silhouette against the sky exhibits fine-grained, high-frequency serrations with low amplitude variation.
